About me

A student by day, a storyteller by heart

I'm Ahsanul Haque, a CSE student at Northern University Bangladesh and a writer who believes the past explains the present. Through Ahsan Knows, I write about history, historical figures, politics, sports and society — in both English and Bengali — so readers back home can enjoy big stories in their own words.

People who know me describe me as a friendly person who listens first. I never judge anyone for who they are or what they're going through, and if someone comes to me for help, I do my best to actually help. I put real effort into keeping my friendships alive — a friendship, to me, is something you look after.

That's also why people often come to me to talk things through. I have no professional degree in counselling — but many friends say my listening and mentoring have genuinely helped them, and I'm grateful for that trust.
